content.text: Section 11 fully addresses the rule. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form.
input.rationale: Section 11 meets the preferred position in full: Section 11.1 gives us up to six months of transition assistance on expiry or termination for any reason, at the expiring Order Form rates (and includes knowledge transfer, export support and cooperation with a replacement supplier at then-current scope and service levels); Section 11.2 requires return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format, with an express bar on withholding data over a fee dispute; and Section 11.3 requires secure deletion with written officer certification, subject only to legally required retention that remains protected. Section 16.5 confirms Customer Data continues to be governed by Sections 11 and 15, so confidentiality return/destroy duties do not cut across these exit rights. No walk-away features (no immediate deletion, no refusal to return data) are present, so no redline is needed.
